mapper.sql: id, user_id, resource_id, status, selected_bytes, verified_bytes, priority, speed_limit, target_subdirectory, error_code, error_message, version, created_at, updated_at, started_at, completed_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO download_task_file (id, task_id, file_index, selected, verified_bytes, export_state) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{fileIndex}, #{selected}, #{verifiedBytes}, #{exportState})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, file_index, selected, verified_bytes, export_state FROM download_task_file WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY file_index
SELECT FROM download_task WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('QUEUED','STARTING','DOWNLOADING','VERIFYING','RETRY_WAIT','REPAIRING')
mapper.update: UPDATE download_task SET status = #{task.status}, verified_bytes = #{task.verifiedBytes}, priority = #{task.priority}, speed_limit = #{task.speedLimit}, error_code = #{task.errorCode}, error_message = #{task.errorMessage}, version = #{task.version}, updated_at = #{task.updatedAt}, started_at = #{task.startedAt}, completed_at = #{task.completedAt}, deleted_at = #{task.deletedAt} WHERE id = #{task.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM download_task WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT t.status, CASE WHEN r.version_type = 'HTTP' THEN 'ARIA2' ELSE 'LIBTORRENT' END AS engine_type, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM download_task t JOIN torrent_resource r ON r.id = t.resource_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.status, engine_type
